name: TaxSetu
tagline: Income-tax e-filing where the last night before the deadline is the busiest of the year
summary: TaxSetu lets 8 crore taxpayers file income-tax returns: PAN and Aadhaar login, prefilled data, return forms, validation and tax computation, uploads, challan payments, e-verification, refunds and notifications. On the last night before the 31 July deadline traffic runs at four times normal all day and fifteen times normal from 22:00 to midnight. Stuck uploads, missing challans and late e-verification OTPs keep coming back.

tour.headline: Uploads are processed inside the web request, so every deadline night ends with returns stuck in 'processing'; a durable queue costs 12 hours.

incidents.title: Prefill took 2 minutes to load on the deadline evening
incidents.desc: Opening a return took up to 2 minutes on the evening of 31 July as prefill data was fetched again and again.
whys: Opening a return took 2 minutes
Each form step re-fetched AIS and 26AS data
Every form step fetches prefill data live instead of once per session
incidents.fix: Added servers to the prefill service.
incidents.lesson: The same data was fetched six times per return.

incidents.title: Aadhaar OTP for e-verification arrived after 15 minutes
incidents.desc: Taxpayers trying to e-verify on deadline night got OTPs after 15 minutes while reminder SMS went out.
whys: E-verification OTPs arrived late
OTP messages waited behind bulk reminder SMS
E-verification OTPs share the SMS queue with bulk reminder messages
incidents.lesson: Reminders and OTPs peak on the same night.

incidents.title: Draft lost when the session expired during filing
incidents.desc: Taxpayers filling long schedules lost 15 minutes of entries when their session expired.
whys: Taxpayers lost entered data
The session expired after 15 minutes and unsaved pages were discarded
Sessions expire after 15 minutes without saving the draft
incidents.fix: Showed a warning a minute before expiry.
incidents.lesson: People filling capital gains schedules take longer than 15 minutes.

incidents.title: Challan paid but not shown while filing
incidents.desc: Self-assessment tax paid in the morning did not appear in the return, so the return showed tax payable.
whys: Paid tax was not credited in the return
The bank's challan confirmation reached the portal two days later
Tax challans are not reconciled with bank payments before filing
incidents.fix: Asked taxpayers to enter challan details by hand.

incidents.title: Valid returns rejected with 'tax computation mismatch'
incidents.desc: Correct returns claiming the section 87A rebate were rejected by validation.
whys: Correct returns were rejected
The form and the validation engine computed the rebate differently
Tax computation rules are duplicated in the form and the validation engine
incidents.fix: Patched the validation engine's copy of the rule.
incidents.lesson: Two copies of a rule drift apart.

incidents.title: JSON uploads stuck at 'processing' at 23:40
incidents.desc: On deadline night returns uploaded from the offline utility stayed at 'processing' and many requests timed out.
whys: Uploads never completed
Each upload was processed inside the web request and timed out
Uploads are processed synchronously in the web request
incidents.lesson: Longer requests held more servers busy.

incidents.title: Refunds failed for accounts with old IFSC codes
incidents.desc: Refunds bounced for taxpayers whose bank branches had merged; the accounts were never checked.
whys: Refunds bounced
Bank accounts were not checked until payout
Refund bank accounts are validated only at payout time
incidents.fix: Asked taxpayers to update their accounts.

incidents.title: Login slow for 20 minutes on the advance-tax deadline
incidents.desc: Logins took over a minute on 15 September as each login scanned the password history table.
whys: Logins took over a minute
Each login scanned the whole password history table
Login looks up password history with a full table scan
incidents.fix: Skipped the history check on deadline days.
incidents.lesson: Skipping a check is a security risk.

incidents.title: Form pages failing with 'pool exhausted' at 22:30
incidents.desc: Taxpayers could not save forms for 15 minutes as prefill fetches held database connections.
whys: Taxpayers could not save forms
Prefill fetches held database connections for each form step
Every form step fetches prefill data live instead of once per session

incidents.title: E-verification OTP delayed during a reminder SMS blast
incidents.desc: OTPs for Aadhaar e-verification took 10 minutes while 'file before the deadline' reminders were sent.
whys: OTPs were delayed
Reminder SMS filled the shared queue
E-verification OTPs share the SMS queue with bulk reminder messages
incidents.lesson: Someone will schedule them in the evening again.

incidents.title: AIS prefill timing out for salaried taxpayers
incidents.desc: Prefill for salaried taxpayers timed out as the same data was fetched for every page.
whys: Prefill timed out
AIS data was fetched again on every page
Every form step fetches prefill data live instead of once per session

incidents.title: Section 87A rebate rejected by validation
incidents.desc: Returns with income just under the rebate limit were rejected after a rounding change in one copy of the rule.
whys: Correct rebates were rejected
Rounding was changed in the form but not in validation
Tax computation rules are duplicated in the form and the validation engine

incidents.title: Upload processing stuck for 2 hours at the deadline
incidents.desc: Uploads queued up in web servers and stayed in processing for two hours before midnight.
whys: Uploads stayed in processing
Web servers were busy processing earlier uploads
Uploads are processed synchronously in the web request
incidents.lesson: Processing should not need a web server.

incidents.title: Self-assessment tax payment not reflected
incidents.desc: Tax paid through net banking did not appear in returns for 3 days.
whys: Paid tax was missing from returns
Bank confirmations were delayed and nothing matched them
Tax challans are not reconciled with bank payments before filing
incidents.fix: Uploaded the bank's file by hand.
incidents.lesson: Every deadline, the same manual upload.

incidents.title: Validation engine timing out under load
incidents.desc: Validation took over 60 seconds per return as each run fetched prefill data again.
whys: Validation took over 60 seconds
Each validation fetched prefill data again
Every form step fetches prefill data live instead of once per session
incidents.lesson: Skipped checks let wrong returns through.

incidents.title: Taxpayers lost drafts after 15 minutes idle
incidents.desc: Drafts of long returns were lost when taxpayers paused to find documents.
whys: Drafts were lost
The session expired without saving
Sessions expire after 15 minutes without saving the draft

incidents.title: Refund failed due to an unvalidated bank account
incidents.desc: Refunds bounced for accounts closed before filing.
whys: Refunds bounced
The account was checked only at payout
Refund bank accounts are validated only at payout time
incidents.fix: Reissued refunds after taxpayers updated accounts.

incidents.title: OTP for e-verification not received tonight
incidents.desc: Taxpayers report e-verification OTPs arriving after 10 minutes while reminders are being sent.
whys: OTPs are late
Bulk reminders are in the same SMS queue
E-verification OTPs share the SMS queue with bulk reminder messages

incidents.title: Challan payments missing from returns
incidents.desc: Payments made this week are not visible while filing; returns show tax payable.
whys: Paid tax is missing from returns
Bank confirmations have not been matched
Tax challans are not reconciled with bank payments before filing

incidents.title: Return uploads stuck in processing
incidents.desc: Uploads have been stuck in 'processing' since 22:00 tonight as web servers process them one by one.
whys: Uploads are stuck in processing
Processing happens inside the web request
Uploads are processed synchronously in the web request

debts.title: Precompute prefill data once per session and serve it cached
debts.desc: Fetch AIS, 26AS and Form 16 data once at login, precompute the prefill and serve it cached to every form step and validation.
debts.cause: Every form step fetches prefill data live instead of once per session

debts.title: Separate priority queue for e-verification OTP SMS
debts.desc: Send e-verification OTPs through their own durable queue and SMS route, ahead of any bulk reminder messages.
debts.cause: E-verification OTPs share the SMS queue with bulk reminder messages

debts.title: Autosave drafts and extend the session TTL while a return is open
debts.desc: Autosave every page and keep the session alive while the taxpayer is active, instead of discarding work when it expires after 15 minutes.
debts.cause: Sessions expire after 15 minutes without saving the draft

debts.title: Reconcile challans with bank payments every 15 minutes
debts.desc: Match every bank payment with a challan and credit it to the taxpayer before they file.
debts.cause: Tax challans are not reconciled with bank payments before filing

debts.title: Single source for tax computation rules
debts.desc: One shared, versioned module computes tax, rebates and rounding for both the form and the validation engine; the duplicated copies are removed.
debts.cause: Tax computation rules are duplicated in the form and the validation engine

debts.title: Process uploads asynchronously from a durable queue
debts.desc: Accept the upload, put it on a durable queue and process it with workers; the taxpayer sees progress instead of a hanging request.
debts.cause: Uploads are processed synchronously in the web request

debts.title: Bank account validation when the return is filed
debts.desc: Check the refund bank account with the bank at filing time, a structured validation of account number and IFSC, and ask the taxpayer to fix it then, not months later.
debts.cause: Refund bank accounts are validated only at payout time

debts.title: Index the password history table by PAN
debts.desc: Add an index on PAN so login reads only the taxpayer's own history instead of a full table scan.
debts.cause: Login looks up password history with a full table scan

debts.title: Separate connection pools for filing and batch processing jobs
debts.desc: Refund and notice batch jobs get their own pool so they never take connections needed for filing.

debts.title: Load test the deadline night at 15x
debts.desc: Replay a deadline night at 15 times normal traffic against staging every June.

debts.title: Rate limit bulk reminder campaigns on deadline day
debts.desc: Throttle reminder SMS and email campaigns during peak hours so they cannot crowd out OTPs and confirmations.

debts.title: Unit tests for rebate and surcharge edge cases
debts.desc: Unit tests for incomes at the rebate and surcharge limits, run against the shared tax rules.

debts.title: Rate limits and CAPTCHA after failed PAN logins
debts.desc: Rate limit login attempts per PAN, device and IP, and ask for a CAPTCHA after repeated failures, so password-guessing bots cannot crowd out taxpayers.

debts.title: Use IST for the filing deadline cut-off
debts.desc: The deadline is checked in IST so returns filed at 23:59 are on time.

events.name: Credential stuffing on PAN login
events.description: On deadline night a botnet tries leaked PAN and password pairs, adding up to twenty-five times normal traffic to login and OTP messages while taxpayers rush to file.
